faqs.question: Which Schengen country should I apply to?
faqs.answer: The country of main destination (longest stay). If equal, often first entry. SK helps choose correctly.

faqs.answer: Short stay usually max 90 days in any 180-day period — confirm your sticker.

Schengen visit from Pakistan — main destination rule

Apply to the country that is your main destination (longest stay or main purpose). Shopping for the “easiest embassy” while planning most nights elsewhere is a classic refusal reason.

Where Pakistanis apply (Schengen)

Each Schengen state appoints VFS, TLS, BLS or AEG centres in Pakistan. You must use the centre for the country you apply through — not a random EU flag on a broker’s poster.

File partMust show
ItineraryDays, cities, transport that match hotel/invite
InsuranceSchengen-compliant medical cover for full trip (typically €30,000+)
FundsTrip cost + life continuing in Pakistan
TiesJob leave, business, family — return intent
BiometricsVFS/TLS appointment with complete set

Sample 7-day tourism evidence set

  • Day-by-day city plan matching hotel bookings
  • Return flight reservation (understand cancellation rules)
  • Travel insurance covering the full Schengen period
  • Employer NOC / leave letter with joining date back at work
  • 6 months bank statements + salary slips

Tourism vs family vs business visit

  • Tourism: hotels + day plan; no fake “uncle” sponsors
  • Family: invitation + host status docs + your ties still matter
  • Business: company letters both sides; meetings that look real

Multi-country itineraries

If you visit France and Italy, apply where you spend the most nights. Split itineraries engineered only to chase a “weaker” visa centre are a known risk pattern.

Schengen visit is not work or study

Short stays cannot start a job or degree. See study hub and work hub.
